note: An image service's own resize operation (uploadcare "/-/resize/400/") comes off first.
A CMS image cache run (Magento "/media/catalog/product/cache/<hash>/"): the uploaded original at the same path without it (live #273 jtfcorp.com: 600x600 cached, 900x515 original).
A shop image type after the image id (PrestaShop "/308628-large_default/"): the original (live #250 dataspot.ro: 554x554 typed, 900x900 original).
The largest stock PrestaShop image type (live #250 dataspot.ro: thickbox_default 1275x800).
A width bucket (BigCommerce "/stencil/320w/"): the original, 1280x1280 where the bucket gave 320x320.
A width bucket at a large size (BigCommerce "/stencil/1280w/").
A transformation segment of comma-separated parameters with a width or height (Cloudinary "/c_fill,w_300,h_300/"): without it, the original.
A size in the file name (Shopify "_300x", WordPress "-500x500", also before a "-1" duplicate counter, retina "@2x"): without it.
A width in the file name (Shopify "_300x") at a large width.
A width and height in the file name (WordPress "-500x500") at a large size.
A named small size closing the file name ("-thumb", "_s"): without it.
An asset id with its size (VTEX "/ids/2225516-461-461/", live #187): the bare id is the original. A number under 32 is a date part, never a size.
An asset id with its size (VTEX) at a large size.
A size directory (BigCommerce "/stencil/400x400/", "/300x300/") at a large size.
A width segment ("/w80/", "/w_600/", or closing the path: live #278 asus.com "/gain/<id>/w80") at a large width.
A width segment without it (live #278 asus.com: the bare id is the 2400x2400 original).
An image service's resize or preview operation at a large size.
A rendition-coded directory ("/r705/") at a large size.
A small-rendition directory just before the file name, asked for as "large".
